{How does Black typically prepare to fight for the center?} 8... Nd7 {[%wrong
There's a better option. Try again and look for a way to control the e5-square.
] [%hint Retreat your knight to control e5 with two pieces.]} (8... O-O $5 {
This is reasonable, but most players prefer to control the e5-square to
prepare a pawn advance. How should you do it?}) (8... h6 $5 {This is
reasonable, but most players prefer to control the e5-square to prepare a pawn
advance. How should you do it?}) (8... e5 $2 9. Nxe5 {White wins material. Try
again and look for a way to prepare this pawn advance.}) (8... c4 $2 9. dxc4 {
White wins material. Try again and look for a way to prepare a pawn advance in
the center.}) (8... Qc7 $2 9. Qd2 {It's better to control e5 with your knight.
How should you do it?}) 9. Qd2 {Good start! How should you prevent White's
plan to trade dark-squared bishops?} h6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
again and look for a useful pawn advance.] [%hint Occupy h6 so White can't put
a bishop there.]} (9... h5 $5 {Thisis OK, but it's stronger to control the
g5-square. How should you do it?}) (9... O-O $2 10. Bh6 {It's stronger to
prevent White from trading dark-squared bishops. How should you do it?}) (9...
e5 $2 10. Bh6 {It's stronger to prevent White from trading dark-squared
bishops. How should you do it?}) 10. O-O {Nice move! How should Black occupy
the center?} e5 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a way
to occupy the center.] [%hint Control the center and dominate the d4-square.]
Good work! Black has strong central control and fine chances in this
strategically complicated position.} (10... Nf8 $5 {This is reasonable, but
most players prefer to occupy the center with another pawn first. How should
you do it?}) *

useful Ng6 move. White already has to be careful to hold the balance.} (14...

struggle. Try again and look for a way to clear a good square for your knight.}
) (14... Nh7 $2 15. Bxh6 {White wins a pawn. Try again and look for a way to
block the white bishop.}) (14... Bd7 $2 15. d4 {Black doesn't want to
undevelop. Try again and look for a better way to activate your knight.}) (
14... Bc8 15. Raf1 {Black doesn't want to undevelop. Try again and look for a
better way to activate your knight.}) 1/2-1/2
